items.title: A morphism from a proper dimension-1 scheme over a field is finite when no component maps to a single point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a practical finiteness criterion for morphisms from proper dimension-1 schemes (statement lines 322-333). The proof (lines 335-352) is a genuine fibre analysis: properness of f from the separatedness of Y, the dimension bookkeeping that a closed subset of a scheme of dimension at most 1 with no one-dimensional generic points is finite, and the passage from finite closed fibres to local finiteness through the proper-finite-fibre lemma. H2: short, but the dimension bookkeeping and the covering conclusion carry the argument and neither is a citation.
